lines.t: Wind over sand, silence before the storm
Iron wings trace the horizon's form
Israel breathes a fragile vow
Seeking peace that heaven disavows
A covenant carved in shifting stone
Trust misplaced, standing alone
The nation's circle, hearts grown cold
Prophets weep for what's foretold
From the north the shadow streams
Rising tides from ancient dreams
Mercy whispers but none will hear
The midnight cry is drawing near
The martyr souls to the east
Bearing pride not peace
Flames rise upon the sea
The mighty bend unwilling knees
Keep your eyes on heaven, beloved
Yahushua's hand is near
The hour of recompense is here
Across the ocean, empires boast
The merchant queen lifts high her toast
Her silver tongues now melt in fire
Her idols crumble, her song expires
Double measure fills her cup
The smoker sends the water shut
Once she ruled from sea to shore
Now her crown will shine no more
The trumpet calls across the sky, the saints look up, redemption nigh
Babylon's fall, the nation's mourn, yet from the ashes the Lamb is born
Armada sails toward the east, bearing pride, not peace
Flames rise upon the sea, the kings of earth in terror flee
Keep your eyes on heaven, beloved
Yahushua's hand is near
The hour of reckoning draws clear
Israel trembles, the fire descends
Still Yahuwah's hand defends
His fury storms, His mercy stands
Shielding hearts from shifting sands
Mountains quake, the oceans cry
The sun of glory splits the sky
Nations fade but his word remains
Written still upon his veins
Our matter breaks upon the shore
Ancient words fulfilled once more
Lift your gaze above the storm
Salvation rides in perfect form
Keep your eyes on heaven, beloved
Yahushua reigns, don't fear
For the kingdom soon appears
Fire to dust, mourning to song
The meek restored, the proud undone
Ashes fall, the world made new
Yahushua, faithful, just and true
